nodes.prompt: Your cotton harvest is ready. A trader offers ₹5,500/quintal. A cooperative promises ₹6,200 but payment comes in 30 days. What do you do?

options.label: Sell to trader now (₹5,500/q, instant payment)
Negotiate with trader for a higher price

nodes.prompt: You got ₹27,500 quickly but missed ₹3,500 extra by not waiting 30 days.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Negotiation] Cooperative selling usually yields 10–15% more than private traders. Plan your cash needs to afford the wait.

nodes.prompt: Great patience! The cooperative paid ₹31,000 — ₹3,500 more than the trader offered.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Negotiation] Farmer cooperatives cut out middlemen and share profits with members. Joining one is one of the best financial decisions a farmer can make.

nodes.prompt: The trader agreed to ₹5,800/q. A small win! You earned ₹29,000.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Negotiation] Always negotiate! Even a small increase per quintal adds up significantly over a full harvest. Research the MSP (Minimum Support Price) before any sale.
